verdict.rationale: Riskified publishes a structured, per-endpoint REST API reference (/decide, /submit, /advise, chargeback, notifications, login) with an llms.txt and markdown versions of each page. Its Integration Console gives self-service, real-time validation feedback on API calls, which is the only interactive element evidenced. Nothing shows the reference itself has runnable 'try it' examples, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: evidence of in-reference runnable/try-it request examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
